en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a waterfront walkway with three people (two adults and a child) walking along a path next to a body of water. There is a railing along the water and a cityscape with multi-story buildings in the background. In the distance, a church steeple is visible, rising above the rooftops. The style of clothing suggests early 20th century. The word 'Hamar' is visible in the lower left corner.
